name: tracely
description: Tracely — a private, local AI writing and research assistant that strengthens the credibility of what you write.
author: Tracely

scripts.dist:win: npm run fetch-models && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run fetch-models && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.release:win: npm run preflight && npm run fetch-models && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.preview:win: npm run fetch-models && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --publish always -c.appId=com.tracely.app.preview -c.productName="Tracely Preview" -c.extraMetadata.name=tracely-preview -c.publish.releaseType=prerelease -c.publish.channel=beta -c.directories.output=release-preview
